newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends firmer, helped by NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends firmer, helped by NY.

text.p: London's spot month August white sugar contract ended firmer on Wednesday after breaking nearby $320 resistance, traders said.

August ended up $2.50 at $321.40 per tonne, just 10 cents off the day's high. Traders said the rally was sparked by mainly outright dealings, adding that the firmness on July raws was also helping sentiment in London.
Overall volume at 2,108 lots was boosted by a number of crossed and against actuals trades.
The volume was better than expected considering the absence of major players due to the annual U.S. Cane Sugar Refiners' Association Dinner in New York on Wednesday, traders said.
Producer pricing was said to be keeping a lid on nearby London prices.
